eslint-js/no-restricted-syntax.message: switch is banned here: use ts-pattern's match(..).exhaustive()
nested ternaries are banned here: one level max, otherwise ts-pattern's match()

try/catch is banned here: return a neverthrow Result (fromThrowable / fromAsyncThrowable); try/finally alone is fine. Note: agents/claude/*.ts is on this floor because it's BG3-graduated (repo-root node_modules resolves through the ~/.claude symlink via realpath) -- agents/claude/hooks/*.ts is a SEPARATE directory and stays exempt (runs before deps are guaranteed installed).
